svg.title: Single-seed color ramps: two chroma recipes
svg.desc: Four seeds, each with linear and retained chroma recipes. Hue and lightness are held constant between the two rows. Exact anchors are marked A; gamut mapped colors are marked with a star. Retained chroma maps four blue and seven yellow samples into sRGB, changes muted mauve subtly and leaves neutral gray unchanged.
svg.text: Single seed, constant hue: how much chroma should the ramp keep?
A · Restrained linear taper B · More chroma retained between the seed and each endpoint
Same lightness and exact seed in each pair. A on a swatch = exact anchor. * = mapped into sRGB for display.
B keeps more blue in the darker steps; its four lighter intermediate samples need gamut mapping.
Mapping count: A 0 / B 4. At 700: A #274f90 → B #124ba5.
The yellow seed lands at 200. B reaches the sRGB boundary across much of the darker side.
Mapping count: A 0 / B 7. More requested chroma does not all survive into the displayed result.
B retains a little more mauve on both sides of the seed; the difference stays restrained.
Mapping count: A 0 / B 0. Neither recipe raises chroma above the seed.
The rows are identical: a neutral seed remains neutral, with no hue tint introduced.
Mapping count: A 0 / B 0. With zero seed chroma, there is no chroma to retain.
Fixed OKLCH hue. Lightness endpoints .97 / .20. Endpoint chroma: 5% / 15% of seed chroma.
A tapers linearly; B tapers quadratically. Both stay at or below seed chroma. All swatches show 8-bit sRGB HEX.
Exploration · 21 November 2026 · Illustrative Auto and gamut policies; no production recipe selected.
